verses.english: “Mendicants, it’s hard to find someone gone forth when old who has five qualities.

verses.pali: Dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
verses.english: It’s hard to find someone gone forth when old who is sophisticated, well-presented, and learned, who can teach Dhamma, and has memorized the monastic law.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato dullabho vuḍḍhapabbajitoti.
verses.english: It’s hard to find someone gone forth when old who possesses these five qualities.”
